weeklyGoals.text: Close QMS UAT sign-off and lock the June go-live plan
Get a dedicated IPQ diagnostic session booked before the next HR Fiori user test
Secure business approval of the IBPROM v4 FSD and confirm budget

initiatives.name: IBPROM Production
initiatives.keySignal: Over 85% digital reports KPI in 2026; stable and widely implemented
initiatives.statusLine: LIVE — Stable and widely implemented; over 85% digital reports KPI in 2026
detailBullets: Digital reports KPI has exceeded 85% for 2026, reflecting strong and sustained adoption across production teams
Product is stable and widely implemented across the business, with no open issues at this time
nextSteps: Monitor KPI and adoption to sustain current performance

initiatives.name: IBPROM Topography
initiatives.keySignal: 100% digital reporting for ICL data; non-ICL onboarding pending
initiatives.statusLine: LIVE — 100% digital reporting for ICL data; non-ICL onboarding pending
detailBullets: Digital reporting has reached 100% coverage for ICL-operated machines
Remaining gap: onboarding of contracted/external operator machines (non-ICL) is still pending, with no firm timeline set yet
nextSteps: Define an onboarding plan and timeline for non-ICL contracted operators

initiatives.name: IBPROM Geology
initiatives.statusLine: LIVE — Go-live executed; full 2026 data entry in progress
detailBullets: Go-live formally executed following successful UAT and resolution of all issues from the previous rollback (machinery data inconsistencies, form usability)
Geologists are actively entering data in IBPROM and have committed to capturing all 2026 records from January onward — ensuring a complete and continuous dataset from the start of the year
nextSteps: Monitor adoption and data quality

initiatives.name: IBPROM v3
initiatives.keySignal: Released and stable; DB schema cleanup now underway
initiatives.statusLine: LIVE — Released and stable; UAT closed successfully, full rollout complete
detailBullets: UAT completed successfully with end users, validating new interfaces (Geology module UI) and confirming compatibility with the Power BI data model — synchronization process unaffected
Release delivered on the two extended-scope items validated during UAT:
Production paper dependency: historical pane access extended to other mine roles, unlocking full digital traceability
Topography digital adoption: browser-based workaround validated in the real mine environment — topography supervisors now using multi-sketch tabs in production
Brigada flow validated with HR as part of the release; both HR Payroll tracks now able to build on the v3 improvements
nextSteps: Monitor stability post-release; support IBPROM v4 scoping for HR Payroll Miners rollout

initiatives.name: IBPROM DB Schema Cleanup
initiatives.keySignal: Jira-tracked cleanup defined; not yet started
initiatives.statusLine: Scoped — Jira-tracked cleanup defined; not yet started
detailBullets: Cleanup covers naming convention inconsistencies, string-stored foreign key anti-patterns, and column-name typos across multiple form tables
Fully scoped in Jira; work has not yet started
nextSteps: Prioritize against active IBPROM/v4 work; begin execution

initiatives.name: IBPROM v4
initiatives.keySignal: FSD complete; awaiting business approval and budget
initiatives.statusLine: Scoped — FSD complete; awaiting business approval and budget confirmation
detailBullets: Functional Specification Document written and completed; main feature scoped is work instructions
Awaiting business approval of the FSD and confirmation of budget before development can start
nextSteps: Secure business approval; confirm budget; schedule development kickoff

initiatives.name: IBPROM Shift Handover
initiatives.keySignal: MVP live but not used; scope was oversimplified
initiatives.statusLine: MVP live — released but not adopted by the business
detailBullets: MVP released, but usage by the business has not materialized
Root cause: scope was oversimplified to accelerate delivery, resulting in a product that does not add enough value to the business as-is
Key dependencies: two contributing projects gate this initiative's value — the IBPROM – SAP HR Middleware (unlocks personnel management) and the PowerApp – IBPROM Middleware (currently in UAT)
nextSteps: Rescope with the value gaps identified from the MVP; align delivery with progress on both the SAP HR Middleware and PowerApp Middleware projects

initiatives.name: Geotechnical Domains PowerApp
initiatives.keySignal: App works, but iPad enrollment blocker prevents use
initiatives.statusLine: Live — functional, but blocked from use by a device enrollment issue
detailBullets: App itself works well; business feedback on functionality has been positive
Reporting output is not compatible with the business's current workflow — a gap identified after go-live
Blocking issue: the business uses iPads that are not enrolled in company IT, making it impossible to operate the PowerApp on those devices
Local IT has reportedly been unable to enroll the devices into the ICL cloud
nextSteps: Resolve iPad enrollment with local IT; revisit reporting format against the business's actual workflow

initiatives.name: PowerApp – IBPROM Middleware
initiatives.keySignal: Dev complete; awaiting confirmation to start testing
initiatives.statusLine: UAT — development complete; awaiting confirmation to begin testing
detailBullets: Development completed by the team
Waiting on confirmation from the development team to start UAT
Key dependency: this is another major contributing factor to the IBPROM Shift Handover project
nextSteps: Get confirmation from development team; schedule and begin UAT

initiatives.name: Shift Hours — Production / Miners
initiatives.statusLine: LIVE — Rollout still paused at 50%; IBPROM v3 now live but v4 requirements still pending
detailBullets: Digital process stable

Rollout to remaining mine teams remains on hold — IBPROM v3 has now released, but the specific data entry controls, approval flow visibility, and cost monitoring improvements this track needs are being tracked separately for v4

A structured end-to-end review is pending to allocate responsibilities correctly: IBPROM (operational data entry controls), SAP (authoritative validations), Power BI (cost visibility and exception monitoring)
Requirements emerging from active rollout reflect genuine user pain points and are being tracked separately from the planned v4 scope
nextSteps: Complete system responsibility mapping; define mandatory vs. deferrable requirements; package into IBPROM v4
Target: full mine-team rollout Q2 2026, contingent on v4 delivery

initiatives.name: Shift Hours — Brigada / Services
initiatives.keySignal: Brigada pilot underway with Mine Manager
initiatives.statusLine: Pilot underway with Brigada — hybrid flow validated; SAP ingestion checked
detailBullets: Important nuance: Brigada workflow starts on paper (partes filled by supervisors, entered centrally into IBPROM by an administrative) — digital chain runs from IBPROM entry onward through approval and SAP ingestion
Rollout strategy session held with the Brigada Mine Manager — pilot scope agreed and pilot now underway; progressive rollout to follow
Even in hybrid form, this go-live enables the Brigada Mine Manager to work with Power BI data and KPIs for the first time
nextSteps: Monitor pilot results; plan progressive rollout and training sessions for remaining Brigada teams

initiatives.name: HR Payroll Fiori
initiatives.keySignal: E2E test repeatedly blocked by IPQ errors
initiatives.statusLine: UAT — end-to-end test repeatedly blocked by IPQ system errors
detailBullets: E2E test has not been completed successfully due to recurring errors in IPQ

No direct access to IPQ, which means each attempt requires scheduling user acceptance tests with real users; these sessions have repeatedly failed due to the underlying IPQ issues, not the test design
Tech teams have applied fixes after each failed round, but a full E2E pass has not yet been achieved
nextSteps: Get direct IPQ visibility or a dedicated diagnostic session with the tech team ahead of the next user test; avoid scheduling further live user tests until the underlying IPQ issue is confirmed resolved

initiatives.name: Truck Portal MMA 44-Ton
initiatives.statusLine: LIVE — In production; Phase 2 functional design in progress
detailBullets: Production deployment completed; the 44-ton capacity flow is live and operational
Phase 2 scope initiated — working sessions with SAP (NTT Data), Logistics, VIDMAR, and ARIPLAN underway
Four functional areas identified for Phase 2:
Axle management: axle count travels correctly from the reservation web to middleware, but SAP is using internal master data instead — causing inconsistencies in loading logic and downstream systems
Load capacity logic: SAP axle-to-maximum-load rules need revision
Net weight calculation: currently done manually at the entry weighbridge — automation would eliminate errors and improve operational efficiency
Reservation data completeness: fields available in the web (transport card, driver ID, carrier details) not always persisted in SAP — forcing logistics operators to consult external sources

Active incident under investigation: net weight not appearing in TRS.NET for a specific case — likely caused by message arrival ordering between Operational status update and LoadingInformation update; VIDMAR asked to validate
nextSteps: Validate SAP message ordering with VIDMAR; confirm Phase 2 functional scope with all teams; plan development start

initiatives.name: Truck Portal — AWS Cognito Auth Migration
initiatives.keySignal: Built and documented; rollout to users pending
initiatives.statusLine: Documentation complete — migration built, not yet rolled out to users
detailBullets: Authentication migrated from the previous scheme to AWS Cognito with email-based one-time codes
User communication and supporting documentation completed in Spanish
nextSteps: Schedule and execute rollout to users

initiatives.name: Queue Management System (Suria Plant)
initiatives.statusLine: UAT — Development completed; UAT underway ahead of June 2026 go-live
detailBullets: API contract closed and mock APIs delivered by VIDMAR as committed; development completed on that foundation
Azure infrastructure session completed; VIDMAR server deployed in Azure
New state model in place: PLANNED_RESERVATION / ACTIVE_RESERVATION — handles daily queue trigger and spontaneous/EXW truck arrivals; TRS.NET remains sole source of truth
SMS confirmed as primary channel; URL-based digital confirmation adopted as the inbound reply mechanism — resolves the international SMS routing risk identified
UAT sessions in progress with VIDMAR and ICL dev team
nextSteps: Complete UAT sign-off; prepare for go-live
Target: June 2026 go-live

initiatives.name: QMS Public Site
initiatives.keySignal: Public wiki + docs site for QMS; scoped, not started
detailBullets: Scope defined: a small public-facing website hosting a wiki and a set of public documents directly tied to the QMS project
Work has not yet started
nextSteps: Prioritize against QMS core delivery; begin build once scheduled

initiatives.name: DCA Digitization — Plataforma SIMPLE Integration
initiatives.keySignal: Public-URL API question delegated to SAP team; Oct 2026 deadline
initiatives.statusLine: Architecture defined — critical integration question outstanding; regulatory deadline October 2026
detailBullets: Mandatory digitization of the Documento de Control Administrativo (DCA) applies from October 2026; architecture favors a middleware-over-SAP approach integrating with Plataforma SIMPLE, the free Ministry of Transport-backed platform

Critical open question: whether SIMPLE's Documentation API serves QR-linked documents via a public, unauthenticated URL — required by regulation. Question has been delegated to the SAP team for follow-up with SIMPLE support; no reply yet
Entity registration on SIMPLE not yet started — pending an FNMT digital representation certificate; Integration Kit download still to be requested
nextSteps: Follow up on the SIMPLE public-URL question; secure FNMT certificate and register the entity; download Integration Kit once registered

initiatives.name: SAL VESTA Order Automation (RPA → SAP)
initiatives.statusLine: Functional design closed — Pending effort estimation and IT management approval to proceed
detailBullets: Functional design (DF v3, NTT Data) reviewed, confirmed complete, and approved by business — no additional functional development required
Agreed solution: hybrid RPA + SAP approach
RPA monitors incoming emails, extracts data from SAL VESTA PDF orders, converts to XML, and deposits files in the designated SAP directory
SAP processes the XML to create sales orders automatically, including duplicate prevention and execution logging

Notification design closed: SAP sends the order PDF automatically to the requester; no custom internal notification development needed — users can consult created orders directly via standard SAP transactions
Business validation provided; development approval pending final IT management sign-off together with RPA effort estimation
nextSteps: Receive RPA effort estimation; complete overall cost and planning; obtain IT management approval to proceed with development

initiatives.name: IBPROM – SAP HR Middleware
initiatives.keySignal: Master data not synced; SAP needs to be source of truth
initiatives.statusLine: Pending scope — master data synchronization gap identified between IBPROM and SAP HR
detailBullets: IBPROM and SAP HR are already connected via middleware for payroll data, but master data between the two systems is not synchronized
Target design: SAP master data should become the source of truth in both systems, removing the current inconsistency risk
Strategic importance: this project is a key unlock for IBPROM Shift Handover, since it enables the personnel management capability that initiative needs to deliver real value
nextSteps: Scope the master-data synchronization approach; align with SAP HR team on source-of-truth model; sequence against Shift Handover rescoping
